title: Wrong action or zone encoded (11 cards)
body:
- Cosima, God of the Voyage: `GainLife` instead of draw X cards
- Starforged Sword: gift draws a card instead of a tapped Fish
- Metamorphose: `ReturnPermanentToTopOrBottomOfLibrary`, but the text is on top
- Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset: emblem draws during the untap step instead of the draw step
- Bramblearmor Brawler: boosts cards in the graveyard instead of the library
- Welcome the Dead: counts cards put into a library instead of your graveyard
- Transmute Artifact: if you don't pay, the card goes to hand instead of the graveyard
- Tuktuk Scrapper: "you may destroy" is `MustCost`
- Ghalta and Mavren: Dinosaur's X counts attacking creatures instead of the greatest power; both modes include Ghalta and Mavren in "other attacking creatures"
- Morality Shift and Grow Old Together: missing `Shuffle`
